shortcut.title: Chatelle Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

draft_reply.name: Draft Reply
draft_reply.description: Reads the chat on screen and types a reply into the focused input.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.phoneScan: Scan this code with your phone's camera and open the page in Chrome.
microphone.phoneFirewall: The first time, Windows may ask to allow Chatelle on private networks. Allow it.
microphone.phoneCertNote: Chrome warns that the connection is not private. Tap Advanced, then Proceed. This is expected.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

pauseMediaWhileRecording.label: Pause Music While Recording
pauseMediaWhileRecording.description: Pause music or video that is playing while you dictate, and play it again afterwards.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Chatelle when you log in to your computer.

style.title: Overlay
style.label: Style
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.label: Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

typingSpeed.title: Typing Speed
typingSpeed.description: How fast Chatelle types your text. Normal suits most apps. Slow looks most like a person typing; Fast finishes long replies sooner.

replyKeys.title: Draft Reply Keys
replyKeys.description: Draft reply sends a screenshot of the chat to the first of these providers with a key. Add at least one free key. Keys are kept in the system key store, not in Chatelle's settings.

speechModel.afterStopDetails: {{size}} MB · Types after you stop, with fewer errors

logs.hint: When something goes wrong, copy the log and paste it into your report.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.phoneNotConnected: Phone not connected — scan the QR code in Settings
errors.modelLoadFailed: Failed to load the speech model
errors.typeFailed: Text could not be typed into the active application.
errors.modelDownloadFailed: Failed to download the speech model

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

microphone.name: Microphone
microphone.why: So Chatelle can hear you. Audio is turned into text on this computer and never uploaded.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.why: So your shortcut works in every app, and Chatelle can type the text where your cursor is.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

permissions.subtitleMac: macOS asks before any app can listen or type.
permissions.subtitleWindows: Windows asks before any app can listen.

phonePage.micDenied: Chrome blocked the microphone. Allow it in the site settings and reload.
phonePage.micFailed: Could not start the microphone. Reload the page and try again.
phonePage.replaced: Opened in another tab. Tap to reconnect here.
